description: This file defines the TaxWritePlatformService interface, which declares methods for creating and updating tax components and groups using JSON commands in the Fineract application.

classes.name: TaxWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for managing tax components and groups in the system.

methods.name: createTaxComponent
methods.description: Creates a new tax component based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateTaxComponent
methods.description: Updates an existing tax component identified by id with the provided JSON command.

methods.name: createTaxGroup
methods.description: Creates a new tax group based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateTaxGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing tax group identified by id with the provided JSON command.
